description: The three non-default levels in one host: journald at yes, dbus at tmpfs, cron at read-only. All pass. cron is exempt and sets it anyway, which the check must credit rather than report as skipped — and because cron's level is read-only, the verdict must also say what read-only did not buy: it stops a daemon planting an authorized_keys file and does not stop it reading a private key.
